reply.text:
"Feels broken" could mean a few things, so I'm going to check your squat numbers before I give you cues. Nothing is logged for squats yet, so I'm working from general coaching rather than your numbers. Three things fix most squats that feel off.

First, setup: feet about shoulder width, toes turned out a little, and take a big breath into your belly and brace before you descend. Second, descent: push your knees out over your toes and keep your whole foot planted, with pressure through the mid-foot rather than rolling onto your toes or heels. Third, the bar: if you're back squatting, keep it locked on your upper back and drive up with your chest and hips together so the hips don't shoot up first.

If you tell me what "broken" looks like, I can be more specific. Is it losing balance, hips rising first, the bar drifting forward, or something else? If you have a video, I can open the form check screen for you. And if what you feel is pain rather than a technique problem, that one is for a doctor or physio, not me.
